setup_needed.heading: Your shop is not AI prepared yet
setup_needed.copy: Agentic Commerce is installed. Prepare your existing sales channels first, then connect them to an AI provider.

action_needed.heading: There is still something to do
action_needed.copy: Some of your sales channels are prepared. Finish the remaining steps so AI agents can actually reach them.

ready.heading: Your shop is AI prepared
ready.copy: Your sales channels are prepared and an agentic sales channel is connected to an AI provider.

installed.title: Agentic Commerce installed
installed.description: The extension is active in this shop.
installed.doneDescription: The extension is active in this shop.

prepared.title: Prepare existing sales channels
prepared.description: Enable the required UCP and AI-file settings without configuring each sales channel by hand.
prepared.pendingDescription: {count} prepared, {pending} sales channel(s) not prepared yet.

connected.title: Connect to an AI provider
connected.description: Create an agentic sales channel once your storefronts are prepared.

understand.heading: What Shopware will change
understand.copy: Agentic Commerce uses additional product-data endpoints. For the sales channels you select, Shopware enables the following where they are not already active.
understand.ucpCopy: Makes structured product and commerce information available to AI agents over UCP, and creates a signing key for the channel.
understand.filesCopy: Publishes machine-readable files that tell AI services how they may interact with this sales channel.
understand.notice: Nothing changes until you confirm. Settings that are already enabled stay unchanged, and channels that are already prepared are not offered.

select.heading: Choose sales channels
select.noDomain: No domain, agents cannot reach this channel
select.empty: Every sales channel that can be exposed is already prepared.
select.notice: Only missing settings are enabled. Existing ones are left unchanged.

review.heading: Review changes
review.notice: Shopware enables UCP and the AI files where required. Existing enabled settings will not be changed.
